findings.title: SQL Injection via Formatted String Query
findings.snippet: cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%{query}%'")
supporting_evidence: Direct match of dangerous injection sink at line 11
Dynamic string interpolation inside query or execution sink
counterevidence_considered: Checked for parameterized query placeholders: not found or bypassed by f-string
Checked for sanitization wrapper: none identified in sink expression
Code is located in an unreferenced module; reducing urgency from critical to review
findings.technical_explanation: Raw SQL query dynamically constructed using f-string interpolation rather than parameterized arguments.
findings.potential_impact: Attacker can execute arbitrary database queries or shell commands, leading to total data exfiltration or host takeover.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use parameterized queries (e.g. cursor.execute(query, (params,))) or pass subprocess arguments as a list with shell=False.

Checked for graph GUARDS relation: none found

Code is located in an unreferenced module; reducing urgency from critical to review
findings.technical_explanation: Administrative or state-mutating endpoints exposed without identifiable authentication or authorization checks allow unauthenticated execution by any caller.
findings.potential_impact: Privilege escalation, unauthorized data tampering, or destructive operations.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add an authentication/authorization middleware or decorator (e.g. @require_auth, Depends(get_current_admin)).

findings.title: Blind Exception Suppression (Exception)
supporting_evidence: Exception block silently swallows Exception with 'pass' or empty handler
Zero logging, re-raising, or recovery action executed
counterevidence_considered: Checked for error logging statements: none found in except body
Checked for metric counters or fallback assignments: none found
findings.technical_explanation: Silently discarding exceptions without logging or structured recovery conceals runtime failures, database corruptions, and critical network drops, making production outages nearly impossible to diagnose.
findings.potential_impact: Silent data corruption, unexplained downstream state failure, and extended debug time during production incidents.
findings.recommended_remediation: Log the exception with traceback (logger.exception), re-raise a domain-specific error, or provide an explicit documented fallback.

findings.recommended_remediation: Remove the unreachable code block or fix the premature return condition.

findings.title: Missing Backend Route for Client Call (GET /api/v2/discounts/apply)
supporting_evidence: Frontend client in 'frontend/src/api/client.ts' at line 3 initiates request to '/api/v2/discounts/apply'
No matching route handler found among registered backend endpoints in the ERCG
Cross-file call path verified from 1 caller(s) in: frontend/src/api/client.ts
counterevidence_considered: Searched exact and parameterized route paths ({id}, :id, <id>): 0 matches
Checked for wildcard or catch-all routers (*, /api/*): none found
Checked if target is an external service URL: verified as internal relative path
Code is located in an unreferenced module; reducing urgency from critical to review
findings.technical_explanation: The frontend component requires backend endpoint '/api/v2/discounts/apply' (GET), but no matching route or controller is implemented anywhere in the repository. In production, this causes 404 Not Found errors when users trigger this action.
findings.potential_impact: Broken user-facing functionality, failing client requests, and unhandled promise rejections in the UI.
findings.recommended_remediation: Implement the backend route handler for 'GET /api/v2/discounts/apply' or update the frontend client URL if the route was renamed.
